name: healthcare-mcp
description: Healthcare MCP server providing AI assistants with healthcare data, clinical research, and UMLS-powered medical concept tools
long_description: A comprehensive Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants to access healthcare data and medical information from authoritative sources. Features include FDA drug information, PubMed and medRxiv research search, health topics from Health.gov, clinical trials search, DICOM metadata extraction, and UMLS concept exploration (search, definitions, relationships, and source abbreviations). The server also supports AI-powered concept extraction from clinical trial eligibility criteria, efficient caching, usage tracking, and robust error handling for reliable healthcare data access.
